smartMotor: Control the Power Smart Motor Hub through I2C.
smartMotor.MotorPort: Motor connector shown on the Power Smart Motor Hub.
smartMotor.DriveMode: Unit or mode used by the robot straight-drive block.
smartMotor.motorStart: Start a motor with the selected direction and signed speed.
smartMotor.motorReset: Reset the current motor position to zero.
smartMotor.motorMoveAbsolute: Rotate a motor to an absolute angle.
smartMotor.motorMoveRelative: Rotate a motor by a relative angle.
smartMotor.robotSetMotors: Select the motors used as the robot left and right wheels.
smartMotor.robotTurn: Turn the robot in place using gyroscope feedback.
smartMotor.robotDriveStraight: Drive the robot straight using a distance, time, or wheel-angle value.
smartMotor.robotDriveStraight|param|valu: distance, time, or angle value, 0 to 10000
smartMotor.motorGetAbsoluteAngle: Read the current motor absolute angle in degrees.
smartMotor.motorGetRelativeAngle: Read the current motor relative angle in degrees.
smartMotor.readGyroAngularSpeed: Read the gyroscope angular speed in degrees per second.
smartMotor.readGyroAngle: Read the gyroscope attitude angle in degrees.
